result.reason: The operative language adopts the preferred frequency, notice, business-hours, independent-auditor, confidentiality, and no-system-access protections. However, it omits the required cost allocation: Vendor must bear audit costs unless underpayment exceeds 5% (or 10% under the fallback). Merely stating that Vendor may engage the auditor does not clearly establish that allocation or the applicable reimbursement threshold. The remaining revisions are targeted and professionally drafted.
